integrity: The full twenty-case table is reproduced by a standalone standard-library exact rational checker; its infinite scope is supported by explicit symmetric congruences.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only two vertex-disjoint cycles connected by a single path, without tree attachments. Earlier exact inertia for rose and theta families and known general subdivision and path-response methods are acknowledged. Independent validation and definitive priority determination have not occurred.
title: Complete adjacency inertia of the line graphs of kayak-paddle graphs
